title: Hardcoded credential assigned to a secret-named key
description: A generic secret (generic-assigned-secret) was detected at <image config>/env[1]:1 [fingerprint 0d06e14175b5c9c2, 32 bytes, entropy 5.00, confidence: medium].
remediation: Remove the credential from the image and rotate it immediately. For build-time secrets use BuildKit `--mount=type=secret` (tmpfs, never persisted); for runtime, inject from a secrets manager (Vault, AWS/GCP/Azure) rather than baking it in.
